name.value: Ramada Kelowna Hotel and Conference Centre

description.value: A full-service 135-room hotel and conference centre situated on Harvey Avenue in central Kelowna, offering a range of room types from standard rooms to themed and loft suites. The property includes Mickie's Pub & Patio, an on-site sports pub and restaurant, and conference facilities capable of hosting up to 350 guests. Its location near the Okanagan Valley's wineries and the region's largest shopping mall makes it a convenient overnight stop for touring cyclists exploring the interior.
